objective: The distance visibility rule hides anyone it cannot measure, as a privacy rule must.
userOutcome: A member who hides from people farther than X miles is never shown to a viewer on a guess.
successCriteria: An unmeasurable viewer is refused by the distance rule.
A measurable viewer inside the radius still sees the profile.
mustPreserve: The encrypted-envelope distance measurement in the profile route.
nonGoals: No change to the haptics work, which is left uncommitted.

assumptions.statement: Fail closed is the only acceptable default for a privacy rule.
assumptions.impact: Some viewers with no location will be refused; that is the rule working.

stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.
